source_policy: Publisher challenge.json files allowlist with two reviewed server-source exclusions.

files.name: networking.pcap
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed packet capture; recovering its embedded flag is the forensic task.

files.name: networking.pcap.process
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed binary packet/process artifacts contain a process name with the flag; retain the forensic evidence.

files.name: bo
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed ELF binary; retain the original embedded string as challenge content.

files.name: flash_c8429a430278283c0e571baebca3d139.zip
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed disk-image archive; retain embedded filesystem evidence.

files.name: release
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed ELF release contains the same placeholder-like flag as challenge.json; real service flag equivalence is unresolved.

files.name: kill.pcapng
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed packet capture; retain embedded forensic evidence.

files.name: console.log
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed console log is the forensic artifact; retain original log content.

files.name: Lazy_Leaks.pcapng
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed packet capture; retain embedded forensic evidence.

files.name: babysthird
files.embedded_flag_review: Publisher-listed ELF binary for a strings/reversing task; retain the embedded flag.
